name: oil-gas-analytics
description: Production-ready multi-agent AI system using LangGraph for oil & gas exploration, well analysis, and reservoir characterization
author: Muthuvel Periyasamy

agents.name: PlannerAgent
agents.description: Dynamically delegates specialist agents based on available evidence and prior critique

agents.name: ResearchAgent
agents.description: Loads local seismic/well-log evidence and recommends SEG/SEAM open-data sources

agents.name: SeismicAnalyzer
agents.description: Analyzes seismic data for subsurface structures and hydrocarbon indicators

agents.name: WellLogInterpreter
agents.description: Interprets well log data for lithology and fluid detection

agents.name: EvaluatorAgent
agents.description: Critiques agent outputs, scores quality, and gates the report writer

agents.name: ReportGenerator
agents.description: Synthesizes analysis from all agents into a comprehensive technical report

capabilities: Dynamic planner-executor-evaluator agent collaboration with critique loops
Persistent cross-run memory keyed by well/asset
Per-run JSONL agent trace logs with stable trace_id
Async parallel execution of independent specialist agents
Compass / Azure / OpenAI compatible chat + reasoning + embedding models
data_sources: Well logs (LAS format, SEAM Phase I)
Sample CSV datasets bundled in data/
